00046 UnaryOpUGenInternal::UnaryOpUGenInternal(UGen const& operand, const int channel) throw()
00047 :   UGenInternal(NumInputs)
00048 {
00049     if(channel < 0)
00050         inputs[Operand] = operand;
00051     else
00052     {
00053         int numChannels = operand.getNumChannels();
00054         UGenInternal* internal = operand.getInternalUGen(channel % numChannels);
00055         inputs[Operand] = UGen(internal->getChannelInternal(channel), channel);
00056     }
00057 }
